title: Ender's Game
creator: Orson Scott Card
invention: A crewed projectile fired at the Moon
caseCredit: Joseph Cotten, George Sanders, Don Dubbins, and Debra Paget in From the Earth to the Moon (1958)
summary: Ender's Game is a 1985 military science fiction novel by American author Orson Scott Card. Set at an unspecified date in Earth's future, the novel presents an imperiled humankind after two conflicts with an insectoid alien species they dub the buggers. In preparation for an anticipated third invasion, Earth's international military force recruits young children, including the novel's protagonist, Andrew Ender Wiggin, to be trained as elite officers. The children learn military strategy and leadership by playing increasingly difficult war games, including some in zero gravity, where Ender's tactical genius is revealed.

tech.name: XTEND AI Robotics
tech.description: XTEND AI Robotics Inc is an Israeli defense company that makes human-guided autonomous machine systems. The company was founded as XTEND in Tel Aviv, Israel, and is currently headquartered in Tampa, Florida.
